senses.gloss: m. pl. (v. זָוָוא) change of (cmp. חלף); prep. instead, in place of.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 3:9:4">Y. Taan. III, 66ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>ז׳ דהיות וכ׳</he> (v. <cite ref="E00231"><he>הֲוִי</he></cite>) where it (the ground) used to grow vineyards &c.; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 126">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXXVI</cite> (corr. acc.).
